1.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

2.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

3.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

4.ar: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
4.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

5.en: But man desires to continue in sin.

6.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

9.en: And the sun and the moon are joined,

10.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

12.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

13.ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
13.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

14.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

15.en: Even if he presents his excuses.

16.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
16.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.

17.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

18.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

19.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

20.en: No! But you love the immediate

22.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

24.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

25.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

26.en: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones

27.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

28.en: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

29.en: And the leg is wound about the leg,

30.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

31.en: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.

32.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

33.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

35.en: Then woe to you, and woe!

36.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

37.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
37.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

38.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

39.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

40.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
40.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
